 As a Founding ML Engineer at BehaviorAI, you will architect and deploy state\-of\-the\-art multimodal models for real\-world time\-series sensor data. You’ll design novel architectures from scratch—moving beyond simple fine\-tuning—to power next\-generation wearable intelligence. This hands\-on role involves shipping direct\-to\-user solutions in a high\-energy, proactive startup environment.
   

  

**Location**
 Brooklyn, USA
   

  

**Why this role is remarkable**
* Work directly with founders Cheng Zhang (NSF CAREER Award winner) and Mehrab Bin Morshed (ex\-Samsung Research) at the intersection of academia and industry.
* Influence the core product by designing novel ML architectures from scratch rather than just fine\-tuning existing models for specific hardware.
* Join a top\-tier VC\-backed founding team with significant equity and the ability to shape a Cornell SciFi Lab spinout from day one.


**What You Will Do**
* Architect and deploy SOTA multimodal models (CV, NLP) specifically optimized for real\-world time\-series data from wearable sensors.
* Develop and implement real\-time inference and on\-device machine learning capabilities to ensure low\-latency performance in field settings.
* Drive the technical roadmap for foundation models that integrate multi\-modal sensing to deeply understand human behavior and intent.


**The ideal candidate**
* Proven experience processing real\-world sensor or time\-series data (e.g., image, IMU) with a focus on real\-time inference and on\-device ML.
* Strong background in Foundation Models and multimodal sensing, with the technical ability to build and iterate on complex architectures.
* High\-energy, proactive mindset suited for an early\-stage startup, with a willingness to own technical problems from research to final production.
